description: This file contains shell script functions for configuring, setting up, and tearing down a network connection via a modem using GCOM commands. It includes functions for initializing configuration, setting up the modem, and cleaning up the connection, with external dependencies on various GCOM scripts and system utilities.

methods.name: proto_ncm_init_config
methods.description: Initializes the network configuration with default parameters for device, apn, auth, username, password, pincode, delay, mode, pdptype, and profile.

methods.name: proto_ncm_setup
methods.description: Sets up the modem connection, configures the device, initializes the modem, sets mode, connects, and configures network interfaces based on JSON parameters and external scripts.

methods.name: proto_ncm_teardown
methods.description: Tears down the network connection, disconnects the modem, and updates the network status.
